appliedUpdates.description: Added ECS Component trait architecture note to architecture.md — explains Component is a marker trait, derive macro's value is ergonomic syntax only, as_any/as_any_mut live on AnyComponentStorage
Added feature interaction pattern to cleanup-notes.md — earlier features may leave item-level #[allow(dead_code)], later features should remove items entirely

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Feature descriptions should distinguish between imports and type definitions. The ecs-cleanup feature said 'Remove unused imports (ActionState in input.rs)' but ActionState was a type definition in input/actions.rs, not an import. Workers can adapt, but precise descriptions reduce ambiguity.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: ecs-cleanup feature description mentioned 'Remove unused imports (ActionState in input.rs)' but ActionState was defined as an enum in input/actions.rs. Worker correctly removed the definition instead of hunting for a non-existent import.
